Implemented a partial simulator at [output/main.py](/workspace/output/main.py). It runs on Python 3.11 using only the standard library and supports basic modal state, expressions, coordinate offsets, linear and arc moves, probing, several canned cycles, and trace output.

**It is not a complete implementation of the specification.** In particular, nonzero cutter radius compensation is not implemented, and the full set of error conditions and trace behavior has not been validated. It should not be relied on to simulate arbitrary programs correctly.

I verified that the file compiles, that the supplied linear and G81 trace examples produce the expected motion samples, and that an invalid H index reports an error on the correct line.
